pk.context: 200 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: An antimalarial and antirheumatic whose terminal half-life in whole blood is 40 to 50 days.

clues.text: Mean absolute oral bioavailability is 79% in fasting conditions, and about 50% is bound to plasma proteins. Renal clearance of unchanged drug is 16% to 30% of the dose, and it is extensively distributed to tissues.
Supplied as a sulfate salt; the active moiety has a molecular weight of 335.9. A crystalline powder, freely soluble in water.
An NDA product of 200 mg tablets sold in bottles of 60 or 100.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in known hypersensitivity to closely related compounds; reported reactions include bone marrow depression and QT-interval prolongation.
Treatment of uncomplicated malaria and its prophylaxis, plus rheumatoid arthritis and systemic and chronic discoid lupus erythematosus in adults.
A 4-aminoquinoline antimalarial and antirheumatic agent; the mechanisms of its anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects are not fully known.
The generic name begins with H and has eighteen letters.
